answer: To prevent Sybil attacks in a decentralized economy of autonomous AI agents, networks can employ proof-of-compute cryptography requiring agents to repeatedly wander through complex cryptographic puzzles. An attacker must expend massive computational energy to reach the verification summit for each artificial identity created, making the cost of generating fake nodes economically prohibitive. Just as a human poet crafts a sonnet through deliberate, resource-intensive labor, each legitimate agent must prove its authenticity via unforgeable cryptographic expenditure.
